args.query:
-- compute 90-day retention by acquisition channel: cohort = signup date; retention = share of users who were active in day 90 (signup_date + 89) after signup within cohorts? Likely 90-day retention defined as percent of users who are active at least once between day 90? I'll implement: for users who signed up between 2026-03-01 and 2026-07-12? But governance required. Instead compute overall 90-day retention by channel across all cohorts where 90 days passed through 2026-07-12.
WITH users_cohort AS (
  SELECT user_id, channel, signup_date
  FROM dim_users
  WHERE user__is_internal = FALSE OR user__is_internal IS NULL
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT user_id, channel, signup_date, date(signup_date) as sd
  FROM users_cohort
  WHERE signup_date <= date('2026-04-13') -- so 90 days completed by 2026-07-12
),
activity_90 AS (
  SELECT e.user_id, e.channel, count(distinct a.active_date) as act_days,
         MAX(CASE WHEN a.active_date = date(e.signup_date,'+89 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_on_day90,
         MAX(CASE WHEN a.active_date BETWEEN date(e.signup_date,'+0 day') AND date(e.signup_date,'+89 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_within_90
  FROM eligible e
  LEFT JOIN fct_user_days a ON a.user_id = e.user_id
  GROUP BY e.user_id, e.channel
)
SELECT channel, count(*) as users, sum(active_within_90) as active_within_90, round(100.0*sum(active_within_90)/count(*),4) as pct_within_90
FROM activity_90
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY pct_within_90 DESC;
